name: The Meridian Compact Report
description: GLMZ's most-watched licensed news program, produced by Vantablack's Compact News subsidiary and broadcast nightly to Tier 2 through Tier 4 subscribers. Anchored by the composed and authoritative Priya Osei-Nakamura's estranged sister, Devika, the program delivers thoroughly fact-checked, carefully framed reporting that never contradicts a licensed corponation and rarely asks questions that haven't been pre-approved through the Content Accord. The production values are extraordinary.
cultural_impact: The Meridian Compact Report is so trusted by its audience that 'Compact-verified' has entered common usage as a term for information that is technically accurate but strategically incomplete.
story_hooks: A Compact News field producer quietly passes a party member raw, unedited footage of an incident that the final broadcast version presented very differently
Devika Osei-Nakamura has gone off-script twice in recent broadcasts — tiny, almost imperceptible deviations — and someone wants to know if she's being coerced or is trying to signal something
The party must discredit a Compact Report story that is about to destroy an innocent person, without access to the editorial infrastructure that controls the narrative
